test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In the question below there are three statements followed by two conclusions I and II. You have to take the three given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and then decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the three statements disregarding commonly known facts.

**Statements**:

 
• 
 
All Hilux are Truck.

 
 
• 
 
Some Truck are Flat.

 
 
• 
 
Only Flat are Fit.

 

**Conclusions**:

 
• 
 
I. Some Hilux are not Fit.

 
 
• 
 
II. All Flat can never be Truck.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
**Given Statements:**

 
• All Hilux are Truck.
 
• Some Truck are Flat.
 
• Only Flat are Fit. (Note: This implies "All Fit are Flat" and "Fit cannot be anything else").
